slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.0.3
slides.subtitle: Drag classes, flames and fixes
slides.summary: Race new drag classes, bet on heats, find a new street venue and watch real fuel light up your exhaust.

slides.title: 19 classes, four leagues
slides.summary: Sanctioned drags add ten classes and a new league, and you can bet on the heats you watch.
facts: Outlaw Drag League lets uncaged cars race
New classes from Unlimited Stick to AWD Unlimited
Bet on NPC heats while you watch; the race waits for you
Registration, standings and brackets are easier to read
The phone shows your status and next step at every stage

slides.kicker: No Prep Knights and car meets
slides.title: Race in the storm drain
slides.summary: Belasco Sewer is a new No Prep Knights venue, and the other five venues get a fresh setup.
facts: Haggle over car-meet race terms with counteroffers
Your lost pink-slip car is on display at that night's meet
Return to the meet with one button after a race
Running wide past the lane edge no longer disqualifies you

slides.title: Flames from real fuel
slides.summary: Exhaust flames and smoke now come from the fuel your engine doesn't burn.
facts: Each fuel has its own flame, from gasoline to nitromethane
Nitromethane burns with a white core and a gold edge
Rich diesel tunes leave dark smoke behind the flame
Flames stay on the exhaust tip at speed
Race fuels cost less, especially at Alder Dragway

slides.title: Build it, tune it, share it
slides.summary: Share a build from the garage computer and push your engine further.
facts: Export a build and its fuel setup as a ZIP to share
New Alcohol Race and Top Fuel injection tiers
Automatic clutch and converter limits follow your tuned power
Rename or delete saved Fuel & Ignition maps
Remove or delete Engine Works blueprints

slides.title: Drift Playground and fixes
slides.summary: A new drift event opens on West Coast, and jobs, repairs and long sessions get a round of fixes.
facts: Drift Playground replaces Drift Loop Remaster
Five drift events have new score goals
Long play sessions stay smoother
Job Broker keeps every load in view after travel and pickups
One loaner cut per delivery, and never below zero
